Update the existing section sections/promo-grid.liquid. Keep the {% schema %}...{% endschema %} block byte-for-byte unchanged. Only the markup above it should change. Inputs. There are no top-level variables other than `section`. - section.settings.title: string or null. - section.settings.badge: string or null. - section.blocks: array, possibly empty. Each block has `type` (string, e.g. "promo" or "divider") and `settings`. Every block, of any type, has settings.heading, settings.link_label and settings.link_url, each a string or null. Tile: a block is a tile only when its type is exactly "promo" and its heading, stripped of leading and trailing whitespace, is non-empty (null counts as empty). Every other block is skipped entirely.
